scope.style: Authored shallow native geometry over the retained source shell. Photo observation informs a small number of facade cues; dimensions and unobserved faces are authored. The single extruded source footprint can combine real volumes, so podium/tower massing is not invented or corrected.

observed: Silver vertical ribs divide dark repeated window strips.
Pale stone lower surfaces and a dark upper crown contrast with the window field.
not_observed: Exact rib spacing, all rear elevations and measured tower/podium heights.
references.used_as: Visual observation only; no photo, logo, drawing or third party model imported.

observed: Repeated faceted/hexagonal surrounds frame the main room-window field.
A broad light upper fascia and several dark horizontal podium ribbons are visible.
not_observed: Exact window dimensions, rear geometry and complete surveyed envelope.
references.used_as: Authored shallow faceted surrounds and fascia proportions only.

observed: Dark rectangular glazing, a light stone side/end wall and thin horizontal window divisions.
Street-level pale stone piers and red-brown fabric awnings.
not_observed: Complete tower elevation and measured canopy dimensions.
references.used_as: Authored glass grid, pale edge piers and short ground awnings.

observed: Pale vertical piers group regular square window fields.
The upper crown has separately framed light/dark portions.
not_observed: Exact grouping counts, heights and all entry elevations.
references.used_as: Authored grouped piers and crown bands entirely below retained source top.

named_buildings.observation_limit: Retail identity comes from source name/shop tag. This profile is authored, without a verified facade-photo reconstruction.

generic_profile_rule: Named overrides first; source tourism/building/shop tags next; otherwise source height, footprint area and aspect ratio determine one of six structural archetypes. These are game display types, not verified tenancies.
geometry_height_policy: Every ornament remains between source bottom+0.05 and source top-0.05. No collision, new roof floor, moved source node or adjusted source height.
